The rebuilt source lacked the declared production rich-newsletter owners. This change restores their original backend/schema/export/dependency source through the existing canonical owners while keeping Q's saved-WsDocVersion-to-existing-OutreachV3 staging unchanged. The rich legacy stage UUID and saved version UUID remain separate; there is no bridge or replacement store/service.

The source delta beyond PR2422 is exactly 76 paths: 58 byte-identical original C/W runtime/spec/migration files plus 18 additive existing-owner/schema/package/lock integrations. Current sender authority and both prospect attachment predicates, notification visibility, credential/member guards, all Q staging source and the four reviewed runtime conversions remain. The 14 historical migrations are source only and were never executed.

Frozen source: a247f7a02a9b94d95e9ee5a516b396202aea994b.
Final author packet: 509e560e1d3b528ff84b63915f235a8a124febcc.
Independent authorization/replay: 6713a190fdb5b9a8495d9cd1ada80d80ab6fe1f1.
Independent source/schema/dependencies: 82f3f6067cb468c6afb4ec710cd9cc08a592aacf.

Validation passes 706 author preservation checks, 67 inert owner seams, 69 independent before/after comparisons plus six classifier/eight prefix controls, 679 independent schema/lock checks, 21 generation/import checks, eight lock/ten schema fault refusals, cached Core typing and five parse-only ownership profiles across 2,219 production files. Cached official WASM/schema and isolated engine-free declaration generation were audited; no native engine or .wasm binary artifacts were emitted, and no native engine, application/client, provider or SQL operation was invoked. All failed and passing evidence remains intact.

Full Workspace typing is unaccepted: the exact htmlparser2@8.0.2 dependency is uncached, leaving six diagnostics. No newer version was substituted or installed. Native PostgreSQL/RLS/migration/MVCC/provider/runtime/bootstrap gates remain open. Review GET can activate a saved reviewer invitation/grant and notify; no actual GET was invoked.

Independent final composition acceptance: e6a2de3e2a804c216f35ebe489f0cd2b2a559994. All 64 metadata checks and 1,385 overlapping bindings across 21 indices pass. The final master covers 270 files and retains every accepted 263-entry file byte.

The precise source/contract/overlap handoff is docs/cleanup-newsletter-two-contract-reviewed-source-20261012/HANDOFF.md. The frontend owner must preserve/port the original rich workflow and its 43 runtime paths/179 static assets alongside the frozen 4a1614886fd98bb42d529f1ef59b3d01d7ff9173 saved-version flow before consumption. No frontend files or abandoned commitment UI were changed. Scoped EngagementService reporting remains with its existing owner, whose future module/provider publication must be composed separately.

Draft stacked on PR2422. No main merge/deployment, real message/upload/model/provider/customer/credential/permission/AWS operation, database/migration execution, package install or security/network change.
